mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05 against the null of zero return.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 with a 3-month decline of more than 5% signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which triggers recession fears and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 90.0 and declines >5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption (RSAFS) following a prior contraction, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST), indicates a recovery in consumer and housing demand, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases >2% in 1 month after a prior 3-month decline
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Fed to delay rate cuts, leading to higher real yields and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high-inflation periods, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market weakening, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines >10k and UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rebound in real GDP (GDPC1) following a contraction, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates a strong recovery in aggregate demand, which drives corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases >1.0% QoQ after a prior 2-quarter contraction
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling regression.
